quiz.q: Shea butter costs ₦5,000 per kg. What is the shea cost in a jar that uses 80 g?
A batch costs ₦12,000 in total and makes 8 jars. What is the full unit cost?
Which description is the most honest and useful for a scalp oil?
options: Guaranteed to grow your edges back
Light coconut, olive and castor oil for oiling a dry scalp; patch test first
Doctor approved for all scalp problems
quiz.explain: It names ingredients, purpose and a safety step without medical or unproven claims.

quiz.q: A customer messages that her scalp is itchy and red after using your oil. What should you do first?
options: Tell her to keep using it until her scalp adjusts
Ask her to stop, wash it off gently and see a health worker if severe, then record the batch
quiz.explain: Customer safety comes first: stop use, wash off, medical advice if needed, then trace the batch.

quiz.q: Which 90-day target is the most realistic and measurable for a new maker?
options: Sell 20 trial bottles and get feedback from 10 buyers
Become the biggest hair brand in Nigeria
Get every salon in the city to stock it
quiz.explain: It is specific, measurable and achievable in 90 days.

quiz.q: Why might an unscented version be a good business choice?
options: Unscented products do not need labels
Essential oils are often a large part of the cost, and many mothers prefer unscented products
quiz.explain: Removing essential oil lowers cost a lot and suits customers who want gentle, unperfumed products.

finalQuiz.q: Which product from this course is safest for a beginner to sell without a preservative?
options: A whipped shea butter with no water ingredients
finalQuiz.explain: Water-free (anhydrous) products do not support germ growth, so they do not need a preservative for microbial safety.

finalQuiz.q: How many grams of essential oil are needed for 150 g of face balm at 1%?
finalQuiz.explain: 150 x 1 / 100 = 1.5 g. Face products should stay around 0.5 to 1.2%.

finalQuiz.q: Which oil is a known skin irritant that must always be well diluted?
finalQuiz.explain: The Tisserand Institute lists tea tree, peppermint, cinnamon, clove, oregano and thyme as naturally irritating oils.

finalQuiz.q: A whipped butter keeps turning gritty. Which step in the method most likely needs changing?
options: Cool the fully melted butter quickly instead of slowly
finalQuiz.explain: Slow cooling lets some fats crystallise separately. Fast cooling after a full melt keeps it smooth.

finalQuiz.q: A balm made with 20% beeswax is too hard for heels. What should you try next?
options: Add rose water and vitamin E
finalQuiz.explain: Less wax gives a softer salve. 15% is a common softer level.

finalQuiz.q: A tester reports redness on day 3 of a skin test. What should she do?
options: Continue to day 10 to finish the test
Wash the product off gently and stop using it
Apply more to see if it settles
Move the test to her face
finalQuiz.explain: AAD advice: if a reaction develops, wash it off as soon as possible and do not use it again.

finalQuiz.q: Which ingredient is a real preservative rather than an antioxidant?
options: A broad-spectrum preservative bought with a technical data sheet
finalQuiz.explain: Vitamin E, rosemary extract and grapefruit seed extract are antioxidants, not preservatives.

finalQuiz.q: Which label claim is acceptable for a cosmetic hair oil?
finalQuiz.explain: Softening and shine are cosmetic effects. Curing, healing or restoring growth are medical claims.

finalQuiz.q: Which is listed in NAFDAC's guidelines as a document for registering a locally made cosmetic?
options: A comprehensive laboratory certificate of analysis
finalQuiz.explain: The guidelines list a comprehensive certificate of analysis along with business registration, trademark, inspection or GMP and labels.

finalQuiz.q: Why should you keep a retained sample from every batch?
options: To give away as a free gift
To compare with a customer's jar if there is a complaint about that batch
To mix into the next batch
It is only needed for lotions
finalQuiz.explain: Comparing the retained sample with the customer's jar shows whether the batch or the storage caused the problem.

finalQuiz.q: Ingredients cost ₦6,000, packaging ₦2,000, labour ₦1,500 and overheads ₦500 for 10 bottles. What is the full unit cost?
For the capstone, why should at least one tester have a different hair type from yours?
options: Hair products can perform differently on different hair types, so it gives a truer picture
finalQuiz.explain: Results vary across coily, curly, relaxed and locked hair, so a range of testers shows how the product really performs.
